verdict.rationale: Firebase CLI supports import/export of Auth users (firebase-gh-1/3) and Firestore/Realtime Database data is essentially JSON, letting one user treat it as an exportable JSON store (firebase-comm-13), but there is no documented full-data export in an open format, no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec (firebase-probe-1, firebase-probe-2), and multiple community accounts describe painful lock-in requiring reimplementation of security rules and business logic if leaving (firebase-comm-3, firebase-comm-5, firebase-comm-6, firebase-comm-15).
